resources.name: PUBLIC-MAP API
resources.description:
Public REST API for PUBLIC-MAP — consumable by n8n, Make, Zapier,
Airtable, custom applications, or any standard HTTP client.

This is a first-draft specification covering the routes shipped so
far: read-only audits/reports, clients (read + a whitelisted partial
update), and creating tasks/interactions (with Idempotency-Key
support). It is not yet exposed through a public Swagger/Redoc portal
— see lib/api-v1/SECURITY.md for the security model this spec assumes
(key format, scope model, error envelope).

Every response — success or error — carries rate-limit/quota headers
(`X-RateLimit-*`, `X-Quota-*`, see the RateLimitHeaders/QuotaHeaders
components). A per-API-key requests-per-minute budget and a per-
organization requests-per-day quota (driven by the organization's
subscription plan, defaulting to a limited Free tier with no active
subscription) are both enforced on every request; exceeding either
returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header — see the RateLimited
response component and lib/api-v1/SECURITY.md.

resources.name: Verify an API key is valid and see which scopes it carries
resources.description:
Requires no particular scope — any active, non-expired key on an
active integration can call it. Useful as a first request when
wiring up a new integration (see the Quick Start guide) and as a
lightweight liveness check.

resources.name: List GBP audits for the authenticated organization
resources.description:
Returns audits belonging to the organization the API key is
scoped to — never any other organization's, regardless of any
identifier supplied in the request.

resources.name: Get a single audit
resources.description:
Returns 404 with an identical body whether `id` does not exist at
all or belongs to a different organization — the response never
reveals which case applies.

resources.name: List audit reports for the authenticated organization
resources.description:
Same underlying data and filters as GET /audits, presented as a
curated report view (score, summary, and an issue-count
breakdown by priority) rather than the raw audit record.

resources.name: Get a single audit report, with every issue
resources.description:
`id` is an audit id (there is no separate "report" entity — see
lib/api-v1/audits.ts). Same identical-404 behavior as GET /audits/{id}.

resources.name: List CRM clients for the authenticated organization
resources.description:
Returns only clients whose `organizationId` matches the
authenticated organization — a client that hasn't onboarded yet
(`organizationId` is null) or that is archived is never returned,
regardless of any identifier supplied in the request.

resources.name: Get a single client
resources.description:
Returns 404 with an identical body whether `id` does not exist,
belongs to a different organization, or is archived.

resources.name: Update a client's own business profile fields
resources.description:
Only `name`, `contactName`, `email`, `phone`, and `address` can be
set — see ClientPatchRequest. The request body must contain at
least one of these fields and no others; any unknown or
forbidden field (including `id`, `organizationId`, `stage`,
`source`, `ownerName`, `notes`, `archivedAt`, `createdAt`)
rejects the ENTIRE request with 400, none of it is silently
applied or dropped. An empty body is also rejected. Same
identical-404 behavior as GET for a cross-organization or
archived id — a failed write never distinguishes "not found"
from "not yours".

resources.name: Create a staff to-do tied to a client
resources.description:
`clientId` must reference a client belonging to the authenticated
organization (verified with the exact same rule as GET/PATCH
/clients) — otherwise the request fails with a generic
VALIDATION_ERROR that never distinguishes "no such client" from
"not yours". Only TaskCreateRequest's fields are accepted;
`assignee` (which PUBLIC-MAP staff member owns the task) can
never be set through this API. Supports `Idempotency-Key" — see
the IdempotencyKey parameter.

resources.name: Log an interaction (call, email, meeting, or note) against a client
resources.description:
Same `clientId` ownership check as POST /tasks. `createdBy` can
never be set through this API — it's populated server-side from
the API key and never exposed in the response (see Interaction).
Supports `Idempotency-Key`.
